acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Kasey, a woman who prides herself on her truthfulness, tries to help host Ira Glass figure out how to stop lying about one specific thing.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass; Produced by Diane Wu

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Producer Dana Chivvis talks to reporter Liz Flock about a strange experience she had in 2011.
Liz Flock’s most recent book is The Furies.
acts.title: The Real L Word

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Host Ira Glass talks with M. Gessen about a lie they've been seeing out in the world a lot recently — the “bully lie.”
M. Gessen’s book on Donald Trump and his autocratic tendencies is Surviving Autocracy.
acts.title: Bully Pulpit

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: We find someone brave enough to stand up and make a case FOR lying. That person is producer Ike Sriskandarajah.
acts.title: In Defense of Unnecessary Lies
